mods.name: Carpet Buzzies
mods.description: Adds the option to change how bee nests generate, including making them generate much more often.

releases.notes:
Quite significant improvements over the previous iteration. The mod is now a [Carpet mod](https://github.com/gnembon/fabric-carpet) extension; this is just to allow the mod to have toggleable functionality, and because I'm too lazy to make a settings system of my own. Plus, most people who are gonna use this mod will most likely have carpet installed already, so I'm not too bothered.

So what exactly does it add?
 * `beeNestGeneration` rule, with 4 different options. This can change how bee nests generate on newly grown trees.
   * `vanilla`: as you would expect, vanilla behavior.
   * `off`: also, as you'd expect, no more bee nests generate.
   * `always`: a bee nest will always attempt to generate, instead of only a 5% (or 1% with mangrove) chance per tree.
   * `always_all`: same as above, except it generates a bee nest in every spot that was considered. You will often get 3 nests generate on simple trees like birch and (not big) oak.
 * `beeNestsGenerateBees`, which can be set to `true` or `false`. This controls whether or not newly generated bee nests will have bees generated inside them.
 * In the previous version of the mod, the entire function for generating the bee nests was entirely replaced by my own code, which is bad. This has been fixed so you no longer have to yell at me. Now only what needs to be replaced has been replaced, and the source code has otherwise been left untouched. (bad explanation cause you can't actually edit source code but **whatever**)
